inheritance.verdict: INHERITS when permissionMode is unset. Explicit permissionMode is applied only when the parent is not bypassPermissions, acceptEdits, or auto. The estate finding that subagents do NOT inherit and that the mode must be passed explicitly is REFUTED by the current published contract: unset inherits, and an explicit mode cannot override a sticky parent.
